title: No More Music
description: A hooded figure holding a glowing lantern stands on stone stairs at night, overlooking a dark river and a crumbling gothic castle under a large cracked full moon. The foreground is littered with broken musical instruments, vinyl records, sheet music, a human skull wearing headphones, and a torn banner reading "NO MORE MUSIC" flutters in the wind.
prompt: A surreal gothic night scene featuring a hooded figure in a cloak holding an illuminated lantern while standing on stone stairs beside a river. In the foreground lie scattered broken musical instruments, vinyl records, headphones on a human skull, and crumpled sheet music. A large cracked full moon illuminates a ruined medieval castle on a hill. A torn white banner reads 'NO MORE MUSIC'. Dark stormy sky with floating musical notes, cinematic lighting, detailed ink and watercolor style.
